args.command: echo '=== services ==='; systemctl is-active zen-mini-taskbar.service 2>/dev/null || true; systemctl is-active zen-mini-chrome.service 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== windows ==='; DISPLAY=:0 wmctrl -l -x 2>&1 || true; echo '=== processes ==='; pgrep -a -u zenui -x tint2 || true; pgrep -a -u zenui -f '/opt/google/chrome/chrome|google-chrome' | head -20 || true; echo '=== enabled ==='; systemctl is-enabled zen-mini-taskbar.service 2>/dev/null || true; systemctl is-enabled zen-mini-chrome.service 2>/dev/null || true; chvt 3 2>/dev/null || true

meta.summary: Verify persistent Mini Chrome and taskbar services
